info.title: configure-env API
info.description: The local configure-env server: a project's schema and env files. Every request needs the per-run token, as a bearer token or the cookie the launch URL sets.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

spec.description: The file, as env.schema.json writes it.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

spec.description: The variable, as env.schema.json writes it.

files.description: Files whose variable list it joins; a file that takes `"*"` holds it already.

ok.description: Every file was written as planned.

values.description: Values by key, as `apply --set` takes them; defaults fill the rest. Templates never take them.

files.description: Only these schema files; every file when absent.

prune.description: Remove the keys a merge or create-only file holds that the schema does not list for it.

replaceProtected.description: The protected keys the edit may replace or remove; any other protected change is refused.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the plan shown, from POST /api/plan with the same inputs; a plan that differs now is not applied (409).

ok.description: No drift, no invalid value, no error.

reason.description: A protected variable's reason, when it gives one.

kind.description: invalid: values that break their rules; protected: protected values the edit may not change.

lines.description: The lines as the file holds them, each secret value masked; empty when it does not exist.

shown.description: The value for display, masked when secret.

expected.description: The schema mode, like `600`; null when it sets none.

actual.description: The file mode; null when the file does not exist.

fingerprint.description: Identifies the bytes read; a value edit names it. Null when the file does not exist; absent when its path was refused.

action.description: mode: the content is current, only the permissions change.

reason.description: Why a file is skipped: create-only and present, an unsafe path, or a mode that would loosen it.

mode.description: The permissions it is written with, like `600`.

currentMode.description: Its permissions now; null when it does not exist.

fingerprint.description: The file's fingerprint now; null when it does not exist.

diff.description: From the file now to the file after; empty for a skipped one.

status.description: set: a valid value, shown; masked: a valid secret, masked; invalid: breaks its rules; missing: not in the file, or no file.

value.description: The value; a secret only ever masked. Absent when it is missing.

error.description: Why it is invalid; never holds the value.

from.description: The env file to infer the variables from, inside the root; `.env.example` when it exists, else none.

fingerprint.description: To replace an existing schema, its fingerprint; without it an existing schema is kept (409).
Identifies this plan; POST /api/apply names it.

ok.description: Whether it can be applied: no error and no protected refusal.

protected.description: Protected values the plan would change without replaceProtected naming them.

plan.description: The plan as it is now.

values.description: Values by key, as `apply --set` takes them; defaults fill the rest. Templates never take them.

files.description: Only these schema files; every file when absent.

prune.description: Remove the keys a merge or create-only file holds that the schema does not list for it.

replaceProtected.description: The protected keys the edit may replace or remove; any other protected change is refused.

kind.description: protected: a protected value that no longer matches the one the state recorded.

reason.description: A protected variable's reason, when it gives one.

root.description: The real path of the project root.

schemaPath.description: The schema file, relative to the root.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).
The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

cleanup.description: Also remove every rule and file entry naming it; without it, a reference refuses the edit.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).
The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

order.description: Every declared variable, once, in its new place.

document.description: The schema file as parsed JSON, valid or not; null when it cannot be read or parsed.

fingerprint.description: Identifies the bytes read; a schema edit names it. Absent when the file cannot be read.

change.description: After a write: the id of the change it recorded in the history, which POST /api/history/{id}/undo takes.

warnings.description: After a write: what went wrong once the file was written, such as the history not recorded.

schema.description: The schema as it is now.

fingerprint.description: The file's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/files; null when the file did not exist. A file that changed since is not written (409).

values.description: The values to set, by key, as a person would type them.

generate.description: Secret string variables to set to a new random value, never returned.

replaceProtected.description: The protected keys the edit may replace or remove; any other protected change is refused.

file.description: The file as it is now.

schema.description: The schema as it is now.

fingerprint.description: The file's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/files; null when the file did not exist. A file that changed since is not written (409).

replaceProtected.description: The protected keys the edit may replace or remove; any other protected change is refused.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

changes.description: Fields to set; null removes one; `path` renames the file.

fingerprint.description: The schema's fingerprint the edit is based on, from GET /api/schema. A schema that changed since is not written (409).

changes.description: Fields to set; null removes one. A new `type` drops the options it does not take.

fingerprint.description: The file's fingerprint after the edit.

generated.description: The keys set to a generated value.

changes.description: The ids of the changes recorded in the history, one per changed key, which POST /api/history/{id}/undo takes; empty when the history was not recorded.

warnings.description: What went wrong after the file was written: the protected state or the history not recorded.

group.description: A heading that groups related variables.

required.description: Whether the variable must be set.

secret.description: Mask the value in output and never echo it in errors.

allowEmpty.description: Whether an empty value is accepted. Defaults to true when the variable is not required.

comment.description: Text written as `#` comment lines above the key in generated files; may span lines.

requiredUnless.description: The variable is required unless one of these is set (non-empty). Not with `required: true`.

conflictsWith.description: The variable and one of these must not both be set (non-empty).

distinctFrom.description: When the variable and one of these are both set, their values must differ.

protected.description: Once a file holds a value, never replace or remove it without --replace-protected. Needs `secret: true`; no effect on templates.

reason.description: Why the value must never change, shown in errors.

default.description: The value used when none is given.

example.description: A sample value shown to people.

patternMessage.description: The error shown when the value does not match `pattern`.

encoding.description: The value must be bytes in this encoding: base64 with padding, base64url without padding, or hex of either case.

bytes.description: The number of bytes the value must decode to; needs `encoding`.
